prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot of the 30-something East Asian Chinese husband sitting on the L-shaped grey fabric sofa continuing from the previous page. He is turning his gaze away from the black smartphone in his hands toward the off-frame television direction, his eyes lifting from the downcast position. The speechless exasperated expression is still in place but the eyes are beginning to come alive — the unfocused middle-distance gaze is starting to point at something specific off-camera, a first faint hint of attention. Eyebrows flat, lips pressed together, two-to-three-day stubble shadow visible, dark circles under the eyes, short black slightly messy side-swept hair. Wearing a loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt and navy blue plaid pajama pants. The TV glow casts a faint cool light on his face in addition to the warm morning window light. Mood: the first loosening of the silence, the still water beginning to ripple. Text watermark 'P09-PN01' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, smiling, wife visible in frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, romantic soft lighting, full Duchenne smile (this is only the onset of change)
